Similarly, the Return on Equity (ROE) of 10.24% [E4] outperforms the sector by a margin of 4.42 percentage points, indicating strong shareholder returns. The Return on Capital Employed (ROCE) of 13.27% [E5] is also higher than the sector benchmark of 11.24%, further supporting the company's ability to generate robust returns from its capital investments. These metrics collectively imply that SONAMLTD is performing better than its peers, yet it is not being fully recognized in the market valuation.
